note: ML-2: sentences where a dictation command word is part of the sentence, plus plain sentences. A polish that loses any `keep` word converted (or deleted) a word that was not a command. Text only: run-dictation.mjs feeds them through the product's final-text pipeline, no audio. ctl-*-04.. are the ML-2 review cases (numbers said with points, noun uses of period / question mark).
